ontology.title: Activity Ontology
ontology.subtitle: Semantic hierarchy used for similarity calculation
ontology.description_title: What is the ontology used for?
ontology.description: It allows algorithms to understand that "walk" and "bike" are more similar (both under "human_power") than "bus" (under "motorized"). This significantly improves semantic search quality.
ontology.custom_subtitle: Replace the default ontology (sidos.txt) with your own .txt file.
ontology.custom_format: Expected format: .txt file, one relation per line (parent child1 child2 ...)
ontology.tree_hint: Click a node to expand / collapse
ontology.step1: Find the nearest common ancestor of two activities in the tree
ontology.step2: The deeper this ancestor, the more similar the activities
ontology.step3: Similarity is normalized between 0 (very different) and 1 (identical)
ontology.example1: "walk" and "bike" have high similarity (~0.67) — both under "human_power"
ontology.example2: "walk" and "bus" have lower similarity (~0.5) — both under "moving" but different branches
ontology.example3: "work" and "sport" have low similarity — both under "stop" but different branches
ontology.no_dataset_warning: Load a dataset first (step 1) before importing an ontology.
ontology.reload_success: Ontology loaded. Tree and matrix updated.
